Initial release of go-jina: a typed, unofficial Go client for Jina AI APIs.

- Provides Go packages to access Jina AI endpoints for embeddings, reranking, model listings, chat completions, and the Reader API.
- Supports API authentication via environment variable (`JINA_API_KEY`) and request editor.
- Type-safe clients with generated request and response types for clean integration.
- Full support for batch embedding jobs and typed error fields in responses.
- Includes guidance on security, usage examples, and when this client is appropriate or not.
